clearer_why: B is more compact and reads top to bottom with a clear structure: gateway with Auth beside it, Agent with Memory and Model API on one row, then tools, storage and the event path below. The legend explains blue, dashed and coral, so each edge's meaning is clear. A is much taller, with Auth, Model API and the event bus stranded far from the nodes they relate to. Five near-parallel strands leave the Agent and run a long way before fanning out, so they are hard to trace. B's weak spots are the long svg detour down the left edge and the execute/svg labels sitting close together.
looks_why: B looks finished: bold titles with small subtitles, icons, uppercase group labels, a restrained blue/gray palette with coral on the Agent and Model API, and a title, subtitle and legend. A is a plain gray-on-gray box diagram with long looping curves and a lot of dead space, and it feels sparse and sprawling next to B.
weak_A: tall and sprawling, with a tangle of long parallel edges from Agent and distant, isolated nodes (Auth, Model API, Event bus)
weak_B: long svg detour around the left, with the svg and execute edges and labels crowding the Tools box; small text
